entities.name: Ring annuloplasty in acute ischemia
observations: In a sheep model of acute posterolateral LV ischemia (n=16), all controls developed MR and coaptation was delayed to 88±8 ms after end-diastole from 17±41 ms baseline; Physio and Duran rings prevented MR and kept coaptation near baseline (30±48 and 25±25 ms). Preclinical result.
